title: RecommendationGate production funnel audit and shadow calibration

audit_window.extension_reason: No complete quantitative candidate existed in the 14-day window.

primary_causes.cause: Odds ingestion/matching produced no persisted snapshots
primary_causes.evidence: odds_snapshots=0; 30 latest fixtures ended NO_ODDS_TRUE; provider monitoring reports both odds providers degraded.
19 latest fixtures ended WATCH for insufficient history.

primary_causes.cause: Bet365-only provider configuration conflicts with minimum two-bookmaker quote verification
primary_causes.evidence: ODDS_API_IO_BOOKMAKERS contains only Bet365 while VerifiedMarketQuotePolicy requires at least 2 bookmakers.

primary_causes.cause: 98.67% of recent run-event fixtures were unsupported
primary_causes.classification: expected whitelist filtering with low operational coverage
primary_causes.evidence: 1125 discovered run-events, 15 eligible. Whitelist was not changed.

implementation_and_auditability_findings: No-selection prediction rows do not persist aggregate model probabilities, so historical model_probability availability cannot be reconstructed.
RecommendationGate reasons are free text and decision_logs contains zero rows; structured stage reason codes are incomplete.
prediction_logger hardcodes odds_source=the-odds-api, preventing reliable primary/fallback grouping.
Fixture analysis currently assigns actual goals to xG fields; this is a provenance defect and was not modified.
Data completeness influences score, explicit completeness gate and risk classification, creating repeated influence that needs separate calibration evidence.
Confidence is decision_score/100 while the Gate already requires decision_score>=85; min_confidence=0.70 is redundant after Gate and is not the zero-qualified cause.
WATCH remains distinct from NO_ODDS_TRUE in persisted decisions; no evidence of WATCH being generally collapsed into NO BET.

common_metrics.reason: No complete quantitative or settled candidate sample exists.

scenarios.change: keep BET rules; expose WATCH/ODDS_MISSING information tiers

minimal_safe_plan: Restore and verify odds event mapping/snapshot persistence before threshold calibration.
Resolve the Bet365-only versus two-bookmaker verification contract through a separately approved configuration/design task.
Add structured, persisted funnel stage and reason-code telemetry in a separate branch without changing betting decisions.
Collect complete and settled shadow samples before evaluating any threshold change.

blockers: No odds snapshots or complete quantitative candidates for calibration.
No settled value-bet sample for ROI/Brier/CLV/Max Drawdown.
Historical funnel stage data is not fully persisted.
approval_gate: STOP; no production threshold or behavior change authorized.
